cohort: The cohort included 440 participants with prepregnancy metabolic and bariatric surgery (Roux-en-Y gastric bypass or sleeve gastrectomy) and 13,434 non-MBS controls who had single-center deliveries between January 2020 and March 2023.
finding: Offspring of mothers who underwent prepregnancy MBS had lower birth weight but higher weight gain at 24 months, with the post-MBS-sleeve group showing higher early-life weight gain and BMI z scores compared to non-MBS controls and sex differences in weight gain.
birth_weight: Lower birth weight was observed in post-MBS offspring compared to non-MBS groups.
